newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 1996 mini vehicle sales down 0.7% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan 1996 mini vehicle sales down 0.7% yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's domestic sales of 660cc mini vehicles fell 0.7 percent in calendar 1996 from a year earlier to 1,705,609 units, the first decline in three years, the Japan Mini Vehicle Association (JMVA) said on Thursday.

Of the total, sales of mini passenger cars rose 6.3 percent from a year earlier to a record 957,391 units, surpassing the previous record of 900,364 in 1995, helped by good demand for recreational vehicles.
But sales of commercial mini vehicles fell 8.4 percent to 748,218 units in 1996, due to slow replacement demand.
JMVA forecast Japan's overall mini vehicle sales in 1997 at 1.70 million units, almost flat from the 1996 level.

But industry analysts said Japan's mini vehicle sales were unlikely to reach 1.70 million units this year because few new models are to be launched and some Japanese carmakers are scheduled to introduce sub-compact recreational vehicles with cheaper price tags.
